questions.solution_en:
15.(a)

Given that, (7x - 4)³ + (3x + 5)³ + 8(5 - 3x)³ = 6(4 - 7x)(3x + 5)(3x - 5)

⇒ (7x - 4)³ + (3x + 5)³ + 8(5 - 3x)³ - 6(4 - 7x)(3x + 5)(3x - 5) = 0

⇒ (7x - 4)³ + (3x + 5)³ + {2(5 - 3x)}³ - 6(-1)(7x - 4)(3x + 5)(-1)(5 - 3x) = 0 

⇒ (7x - 4)³ + (3x + 5)³ + (10 - 6x)³ - 3(7x - 4)(3x + 5){2(5 - 3x)} = 0

⇒ (7x - 4)³ + (3x + 5)³ + (10 - 6x)³ - 3(7x - 4)(3x + 5)(10 - 6x) = 0

Now, (7x - 4) ≠ (3x + 5) ≠ (10 - 6x)

Clearly, 7x - 4 + 3x + 5 + 10 - 6x = 0

4x + 11 = 0

x = - 114

(-4x + 1) = 11 + 1 = 12

Ratio of the numbers

= 13 : 112 : 16 or 4 : 1 : 2

average of the 22nd and 24th numbers = 4 + 22 = 3 unit

questions.solution_en:

29 + 192 - 121 = 100

221 - 121 = 100 ⇒ 100 = 100
